2xl.description: Use for wider separations, often for visual clarity between large components or in wide layouts with considerable space between elements.

xl.description: Use for significant separation, such as between major sections or larger containers in the layout, giving enough breathing room for larger UI pieces.

none.description: Use for no space between elements. Ideal for compact UI elements or when you want items to be tightly grouped together.

6xl.description: Use for large scale layouts, creating significant breathing space between large elements or in massive container-based designs.

4xl.description: Use for very large layouts, commonly used to separate major sections in a page or across large grid designs.

lg.description: Use for separating more prominent UI elements such as between sections or larger components to ensure visual hierarchy.

xs.description: Use for tiny spacing between small icons, badges, or buttons, as well as tight grouping of elements within a container.

sm.description: Use for separating small UI elements, such as between icon buttons, table cells, or text and icons in a compact layout.

5xl.description: Use for large layouts, spacing significant sections of content, ensuring clear visual distinction between the most important UI pieces.

md.description: Use for larger UI components like form fields, buttons, or within cards to ensure proper readability and separation between elements.

3xl.description: Use for major separation in extensive layouts, typically seen in large screen designs with wide space between sections or blocks of content.

7xl.description: Use for very open layouts that require significant visual spacing to clearly separate extensive content blocks.

8xl.description: Use for  expansive layouts with maximum spacing, creating clear sections for large-scale content separation in a visual hierarchy.

none.description: Use for no padding around elements, creating compact layouts or for areas where no extra space is needed around the content.

xs.description: Use for small containers, offering just a hint of internal space, often used for compact UI elements such as buttons, small cards, or icons.

sm.description: Use for smaller UI components like icon buttons, badges, or input fields, where the content needs a slight separation from the edges.

md.description: Use for standard padding size used for most UI components, including form fields, buttons, and card components, providing comfortable space between content and the container.

lg.description: Use for larger UI elements, such as large buttons, cards, or sections, ensuring there’s adequate breathing room and structure within larger containers.

xl.description: Use for large containers or sections that require ample space between the content and container edges for better visual distinction.

2xl.description: Use for larger layouts where generous spacing is required, often used to separate sections or ensure clear visibility between major elements.

3xl.description: Use for large elements or layouts, used when significant space between content and container is needed for clarity.

4xl.description: Use for spacious layouts or containers that require a lot of internal space for content, such as large cards or detailed forms.

5xl.description: Use for extensive padding needs, often in high-impact UI elements, to provide ample space for content in wide sections or full-page designs.

6xl.description: Use for spacious layouts that require significant internal space, typically used for large-scale designs or full-screen elements.

7xl.description: Use for very spacious layouts with high content separation needs.

8xl.description: Use for expansive, high-clarity layouts requiring maximum space to make content stand out with minimal crowding.

9xl.description: Use for vast sections or areas where ample breathing room is necessary for large-scale designs or to separate extensive content blocks.
